task: The person repeatedly assembles and takes apart a small orange plastic toy table made of five parts. To assemble it, the parts are picked up from the desk one at a time and fitted together, usually with one hand holding the partial assembly and the other bringing and pressing in a part; to take it apart, the parts are pulled off and put back down on the desk.

objects.description: one of two long, thin, straight orange plastic sticks; each connects the two H-shaped leg pieces
one of two orange pieces shaped like the letter H: a pair of table legs joined by a short bar
the flat orange rectangular plate with a row of three round holes; the top of the toy table
the orange parts when fully or partly fitted together

source: written by Claude from the 16 take frames; the names gather colour/shape, everyday and technical (furniture) terms, plus the correct ones the plain VITRA prompt used on its own (stick, rod, bar, leg piece, frame, rectangular plate, assembly, structure)
